messages:
kira: Quick sync — we're adding runtime metrics for routing/quota to the new console dashboards. Heads-up: several labels look high-card (shard_id, user_id, route_instance). Need alignment on what goes into Prom/Grafana ingest. Thoughts?

sam: agree, saw memory spikes when shard_id was included in staging :grimacing:. We should avoid per-instance labels at metric-level.

anya: For rollouts UX we need per-route success_latency and quota_consumed, but not per-customer or per-session granularity. Can we map full path -> stable route_id and use that in metrics?

leo: propose a whitelist: service, model, route_id, region, customer_tier. Drop user_id, request_id, session_id from metrics. If org-level aggregation is needed, expose hashed_org (4 hex chars) only.

maria: +1. Also, it'd help to have a canonical relabel example for the pipeline so teams can reuse it.

kira: here's a minimal relabel snippet to start with — we'll iterate. We want to show the intent (drop raw ids, map route -> route_id, hash org):

```yaml
- source_labels: [__meta_runtime_label_route]
  target_label: route_id
  regex: (.+)
  replacement: ${1}

- source_labels: [org_id]
  target_label: org_hash4
  regex: (.*)
  replacement: ${1} # pipeline will run a stable hash and truncate to 4 hex chars
  action: replace

- action: drop
  regex: (user_id|request_id|session_id|route_instance|shard_id)
  source_labels: [__name__, __meta_runtime_label_any]
```

anya: We should keep a mapping table for route_id -> human_name in the console so UI can show pretty names while metrics use low-card route_id.

sam: one question: quotas need per-org quotas enforcement. How do we reconcile hashed_org with billing joins? Is hashed_org sufficient for enforcement?

maria: raw org_id stays in the events/billing DB. Metrics pipeline only exposes org_hash4 for telemetry and dashboards. Billing/enforcement happen in control plane using raw ids. We can link via ingestion ids when needed.

infra-bot: Ingest pipeline rule queued: drop labels matching (user_id|request_id|session_id|shard_id|route_instance) for metrics.runtime.*. Applying to staging for smoke test.

kira: timeline: we need this before the canary dashboard push on Friday. Who can own the relabel config PR and the cardinality smoke test?

leo: I'll open the PR and tag eng-platform + eng-sre. Can someone run a cardinality scan on the staging metrics window? @sam can you run the quick script and paste results? Link: https://go/repo/metric-cardinality-checker

sam: running now... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: results: peak unique route_id ~120, org_hash4 unique ~3k over 24h of staging traffic, metric families stable. No single label exceeded expectations. Attaching quick CSV snippet.

anya: Sounds acceptable. UX note: console will show a small info badge for any label that is sampled/hashed with a link to the privacy/billing doc.

kira: perfect. I'll update the dashboard templates (panel JSONs) to reference route_id and org_hash4, and add a changelog entry. Thanks all :thumbsup:
